commits.message:
Add GeniusLyrics.NET reference and improve lyrics cleaning

Added a project reference to GeniusLyrics.NET in the web project file. Refactored the lyrics cleaning logic in LyricsController to use a static partial method with the GeneratedRegex attribute for better maintainability and performance.
add genius client package into solution for debugging and fixing of loading lyrics
new install
fix corners sometimes not rounding on windows 11
fix double play when playing previous song past 5 seconds run time
add version to download button on website
update website screenshots for new version
fix rounded corners when os is below windows 11
update download script
add changelog to repo
fix current version format
fix a couple warnings, update outdated nuget packages
update project versions to correct version

Prevent errors when window is not active

Added a check to ensure the window is active before proceeding with the handle initialization in WindowHelper.cs. Updated installation script to reflect the new build version 148.

Refactor null checks and remove unnecessary null-forgiving operator

Updated calls to WindowHelper.WindowsRoundCorners to remove the null-forgiving operator. Included additional null checks within WindowHelper.WindowsRoundCorners to handle null window arguments safely.

Add icon to ShellView and update build version

Integrated AppIcon resource and adjusted ShellView to display the application icon in the title bar. Made minor UI adjustments in ShellView and added favicon.ico to the project resources. Increased build version to 147 in the installation script.

Add rounded corners to all primary window views

Introduced a new WindowHelper class to apply rounded corners using DWM API. Updated all primary window views to utilize this helper for a consistent UI appearance. Added necessary enum types and WinImport method for DWM attributes.
remove spectrum analyzer for now

Remove equalizer and visualizer dependencies from controllers

This commit eliminates the use of the Equalizer and VisualizerEngine in RadioController, ShellViewModel, and PlayerController. These changes simplify the code by removing unnecessary dependencies and associated logic, improving maintainability.

Fix static song playback status in PlayerController

Updated the PlayerController to set the current static song's `IsPlaying` status to true when starting a station. This ensures that the playback status is correctly reflected in the system.

Fix player status handling and enhance property notifications

Improved handling of player status by moving `_playerController.Cancel()` safely and ensuring `CurrentSong.IsPlaying` is updated correctly. Added necessary property change notifications in `ShellViewModel` to keep the UI consistent.

Fix `IsPlaying` state inconsistency and update installer version

Ensure `IsPlaying` is set to false for the current song before starting a new one to avoid state inconsistency. Additionally, update the installer script with the correct version and build number to reflect changes.

Refactor media playback and property bindings

Refactor `RadioController` to use `MediaFoundationReader` within a using block to ensure proper disposal. Adjust `ShellViewModel` bindings and property names for clearer semantics and accurate network usage indications.

Update dispatcher priority and add newline before NotifyInterface

Changed dispatcher priority to ApplicationIdle to improve UI performance. Added a newline before the NotifyInterfaceChanged method for better readability in the code.
work on fixing laggy playing
wokr on freeing up ui thread better

Add showIsBusy parameter and optimize dispatcher priority

Added a showIsBusy parameter to RunAsync for optional busy state indication in ViewModelBase. Optimized ShellViewModel with DispatcherPriority.Background for background thread execution. Replaced "NextSong" with "PreviousSong" to correct the logic in PlayerController.

Add IgnoreTracking attribute and update build version

Annotated `IsUpdateAvailable` with `IgnoreTracking` to optimize attribute handling. Additionally, incremented the build version from 134 to 137 in the installation script.

Format code for readability

Separate parameters in the SettingsViewModel constructor for better clarity. Also, remove an unnecessary blank line in UpdateController to maintain code consistency.

Add update button and logic to settings screen

Introduced an "UPDATE" button to the Settings screen UI. Updated the ViewModel to bind this button to the update availability status and added necessary logic to check and handle updates.
remove

Refactor update check to verify existing downloads

Renamed `CheckForUpdate` to `CheckIfUpdateIsAvailable` for clarity. Added logic to first check for an already downloaded update before proceeding with the version check and download process.
remove update file

Add update status feature and integrate it into the UI

Introduced `IUpdateStatus` and `UpdateStatus` classes to handle update availability status. Integrated this functionality into `ShellViewModel` and `ShellView` to display an update alert icon. Added `CheckForUpdateStartupTask` and modified `UpdateController` for checking
fix formatting on website
add current version html page to use to check for need to update

Integrate Spectrum Analyzer in ShellViewModel

Refactored the Song filtering logic to start with an empty sequence, improving clarity by setting an explicit starting point. Adjusted button dimensions in ShellView for consistent UI design. Added a new method to initialize the Spectrum Analyzer in ShellViewModel, ensuring it activates on application start.

Change Dispatcher usage and fix thread invocations

Updated VisualizerEngine to use DispatcherPriority.Background for _positionTimer. Modified ShellViewModel to use Dispatcher.InvokeAsync for async operations and thread invocations to ensure GUI thread safety.

Optimize UI elements and improve search handling

Adjusted various UI components for better usability and consistency, including volume controls and play buttons. Enhanced search functionality to handle empty strings more robustly. Added a new stop function to the PlayerController for improved control.

Refactor VisualizerEngine background worker handling.

Renamed BackgroundWorker and associated methods for clarity. Simplified property assignment and refactored waveform data generation routines to reduce redundant operations and improve readability.

Refactor RemoveSong to handle multiple songs

Changed the signature of the RemoveSong method to RemoveSongs, enabling the removal of multiple songs in one operation. Updated all relevant calls throughout the codebase to use the new method.

Switch Dispatcher to InvokeAsync and Adjust UI Margins

Changed Dispatcher Invocation in VisualizerEngine for non-blocking calls by using InvokeAsync. Adjusted UI margins in ShellView.xaml for consistent spacing. Updated PlayerController to set `IsPlaying` in VisualizerEngine during play/pause actions.

Update ShellView.xaml and Resources.xaml layout and styling

Rearranged window commands in ShellView.xaml for better organization and removed unnecessary window style attribute. Cleaned up extra lines and white spaces in Resources.xaml for improved readability.
update install

Refactor RadioController for cleaner code formatting

Simplified the instantiation of `inputStream` by consolidating it into a single line. Removed unnecessary whitespace for more readable and maintainable code. This change does not affect functionality but improves code clarity.

Refactor exception handling and change async methods

Refactor `ShowException` method to handle exceptions synchronously. Remove async suffix from methods interacting with exception handling to maintain consistency and improve readability.
Fix visualizer not stopping properly when changing radio stations

change SelectedSong to CurrentSong in ShellViewModel when calling lyrics controller.

This change updates the variable name from SelectedSong to CurrentSong to better reflect its usage within the code. It ensures that the song lyrics are loaded correctly using the CurrentSong's properties. This minor refactor improves code readability and maintainability.

Reset VisualizerEngine on player disposal

Ensure the VisualizerEngine is reset when the player is disposed to maintain proper state management. Also, added garbage collection suppression to optimize resource handling and prevent finalization after disposal.

Update build version and reset VisualizerEngine on player dispose

Increased the installer script build version to 125. Added a reset call to VisualizerEngine instance when the player is disposed to ensure proper cleanup and initialization for subsequent use.

Add audio equalizer support to RadioController

Integrated an audio equalizer into the `RadioController` to enhance audio output. This includes handling equalizer initialization and cleanup during playback start and stop. Also, removed commented-out code and cleaned up related classes.

Refactor controllers, enhance VisualizerEngine, and update tasks

Renamed controllers and added new visualizer functionalities to handle streaming. Adjusted async task handling in PlayerController and ShellViewModel for improved error management and performance.

Enhance SpectrumAnalyzer style and adjust UI elements

Added styles for SpectrumAnalyzer bars and peaks in Resources.xaml for better visualization. Adjusted ContentControl width and margin in ShellView.xaml for improved layout. Added a TODO comment in PlayerController.cs for future visualizer implementation.

Rename and reorganize Visualizer components

Moved Visualizer files from `ShufflerPro/Screens/Shell/Visualizer` to `ShufflerPro/Framework/WPF/Controls/Visualizer` to better reflect their usage context. Updated corresponding namespaces and imports to maintain consistency across the codebase. This enhances modularity and aligns components with the overall framework structure.

Add attribution comment to VisualizerEngine.cs

Added a comment attributing code refactoring to Jacob Johnston and referenced his GitHub repository. This change promotes transparency and acknowledges the original author's contributions.

Rename NAudioEngine to VisualizerEngine

Refactor NAudioEngine to VisualizerEngine for better clarity and moved specific methods for stopping and resetting into the VisualizerEngine. Updated references and fixed minor issues with property management and method structures.

Cancel player and reset IsPlaying flag

Previously, the `Cancel` action did not update the `IsPlaying` flag in the `NAudioEngine` instance, leading to inconsistencies. This update ensures that `IsPlaying` is set to false when playback is canceled for accurate state representation.

Improve equalizer and visualizer integration

Replaced ISampleProvider with IWaveProvider in Equalizer class to better integrate with visualizer. Updated PlayerController to initialize and play the equalizer wrapped in the visualizer input stream. Fixed issues with buffer handling and streamlined WaveFormat properties.
first pass at adding in spectrum analyzer
update view

Implement Close functionality and improve PlayPause responsiveness

Added a Close method to AudioEqualizerViewModel and updated the corresponding view to change "Cancel" to "Close." Enhanced PlayPause method in ShellViewModel for asynchronous execution and made various UI adjustments, including the addition of shuffle and repeat buttons and improvements to margin and padding in ShellView.xaml. Updated the installation script to increment the build version.

Add HipHop Classics Radio Station and update build version

Introduced a new radio station, "HipHop Classics," with a streaming URL. Additionally, incremented the build version from "121" to "122" in the installation script.

Add version display and update build version

Include the current version display in SettingsView. Refactored ShellViewModel and ShellView to remove duplicate version code. Updated installation script build version to 121.

Add selected song support to SongQueueFactory creation

Updated the SongQueueFactory to accept an optional selected song parameter. This ensures that the current song is set correctly based on selection, if provided. Additionally, updated project configurations to include a new favicon and incremented the installer build version.

Remove NetworkController and update related UI.

Deleted NetworkController.cs and removed all references to network usage from PlayerController, ShellViewModel, and ShellView.xaml. Updated RadioController to not initialize or stop network tracking, and streamlined the update process in UpdateController. Also added a reference to System.Diagnostics.PerformanceCounter in ShufflerPro.Client.csproj.

Refactor equalizer code, add update handling logic

Renamed class variables for better readability in `Equalizer.cs`. Introduced `UpdateController` to handle software update checks and application. Also updated project files and installation script with version 1.0.2.

Fix null check and clean up unused resources

Added null checks before resetting SearchText to improve robustness. Also removed an unused style from the resource dictionary to clean up the project.

Reset search text on album selection and handle empty search

Reset the `SearchText` field to null when a new album is selected to ensure the search input is cleared. Also, updated the search handling logic to account for empty search text, improving the overall filtering functionality in `ShellViewModel`. Additionally, incremented the build version for the installer script from 114 to 118.

Refactor album and artist collections to ReadOnlyCollection

Refactored the `Albums` and `Artists` properties in `ShellViewModel` to return `ReadOnlyCollection` for better immutability and efficiency. Removed unused `ShowNetworkUsage` property and related notifications. Updated xaml to use `ThemeForeground` for search watermark.

Refactor SettingsView.xaml grid layout

Added margins and new column definitions to the grid for better alignment and spacing. Adjusted row and column settings for controls to improve layout consistency and visual appearance.

Remove redundant image resources

Deleted multiple image files from the Images directory and updated the project file to remove references to these deleted resources. This cleanup helps reduce unused assets in the project, ensuring a more streamlined codebase.

Refactor resource handling and reorganize access keys.

Removed unused image resources and style definitions from Resources.xaml. Eliminated redundant xmlns declaration from StartupView.xaml. Moved AccessKeysContainer to its own file for better modularity and clarity.

Add network usage tracking in PlayerController

Introduced `NetworkController` for monitoring network usage and integrated its usage with `PlayerController` and `RadioController`. Updated `ShellViewModel` to expose network usage and display this information in the UI.

Refactor theme management and screen names

Refactor the code by introducing the `ShufflerPro.Framework.WPF.Objects` and `ShufflerPro.Framework.WPF.AttachedProperties` namespaces. Updated screen name usage in XAML files to use the new `ScreenNameAttachedProperty` class. Renamed several files and adjusted namespaces for better organization.

Set grid.SelectedItem in JumpToItemAttachedProperty

This update sets the grid's SelectedItem to the specified song when scrolling into view. This change ensures the item is both visible and selected, enhancing the user experience.

Refactor theme setting logic and encapsulate revert changes

Simplified theme management by introducing the SetTheme method. Encapsulated the revert logic in RevertChanges method and adjusted the installer version to 114.
fix bug where shuffle and repeat werent being respect immediately after checking

Set default max time for static songs

When the current song is static, set the timer's max time to 1 day. This change ensures the timer behaves correctly and prevents unexpected resets or duration issues for static content.

Update version number and enhance ShellViewModel

Bumped version to 1.0.2 in project and installer script. Improved ShellViewModel by adding DisplayName property and optimizing code formatting. Removed redundant ScreenName attribute in ShellView.

Refactor timer initialization and song play logic

Condensed the timer initialization condition into a single line for brevity. Encapsulated the asynchronous song playback and related UI updates within a `Task.Run` to improve responsiveness and maintain UI thread separation.

Refactor static song handling in PlayerController and ShellViewModel

Reorganized the `_isPlayingStaticSong` field in PlayerController for better clarity and added handling for resuming static songs. Enhanced ShellViewModel to improve timer initialization and handle static song durations correctly, ensuring proper song queue creation based on static status.

Rename and update radio stations and improve play/pause logic.

Renamed ChillHopRadioStation to NeoRadioStation and updated URLs and names for radio stations. Enhanced play/pause handling in PlayerController by incorporating the RadioController status. Additionally, refined the empty parent clearing logic in ShellViewModel for better tree item management.

Add support for pausing static songs in PlayerController

Introduced a boolean field to track if a static song is playing and adjusted the pause logic to stop the radio station if it is. Updated RadioController to properly start and stop the radio streams, ensuring cleanup and resource management.

Refactor codebase: move radio and state logic to Client

Moved various classes related to radio stations and source tree state from the Web project to the Client project. This restructuring enhances modularity by keeping client-related components within the Client project. Also updated PlayerController to handle static songs with the newly relocated RadioController.

Add SourceTreeState to manage static sources

Implemented SourceTreeState class to manage static song states from the source tree. Updated SourceTreeController and ShellViewModel to utilize this new state for handling static sources effectively. Adjusted constructors and properties to integrate SourceTreeState seamlessly.

Add BindableSelectedItemBehavior and refactor tree item handling

Introduced BindableSelectedItemBehavior to enable two-way binding for TreeView's selected item. Refactored ShellViewModel to replace _selectedTreeViewItem with SelectedTreeItem, updating all related method calls. Modified AudioEqualizerView layout and added new buttons.

Add radio stations functionality with Ninject integration

Added various radio stations and their integration into the SourceTree with proper interfaces and bindings. Introduced new controller methods to handle radio station retrieval and playback using Ninject for dependency injection.

Refactor watermark functionality

Moved WatermarkService to a new namespace and updated related references. Additionally, cleaned up XAML markup and optimized the layout for better readability and functionality.

Begin add RadioController to stream internet radio stations

Created a new RadioController class to handle playing internet radio streams via NAudio. Defined two sample radio stations, ChillHop and Lofi, and updated the settings to recognize "lofi" as a dictionary word.
update screenshots on website

Fix bug in HandleMoveSongInPlaylist method

Updated HandleMoveSongInPlaylist to use the first song from the dropped songs instead of casting dropInfo.Data to a Song. This prevents potential casting errors and ensures the correct song is handled during the move operation.
new build

Fix item scrolling in JumpToItemAttachedProperty

Ensure the DataGrid scrolls to the new selected song when the property changes. Corrected the conditional check to match the actual object type being handled, improving the accuracy of the operation.

Refactor import button UI for a more compact design

Updated the 'Import' button in ShellView.xaml to use an icon instead of text, reducing the width and margins. Added a tooltip for improved usability. This change enhances the visual appeal and saves space in the interface.

Refine error messages and UI styling.

Updated the error message for failed song lyrics loading and adjusted UI element margins and styles for better visual consistency. Removed unused namespaces and cleaned up obsolete style definitions in resource dictionaries.

Remove redundant code for hover effect in ShellView.

Replaced the IsMouseDirectlyOverChanged event handler with a more concise DataTrigger-based solution for changing the TextBlock foreground color on hover in the ShellView screen. This change simplifies the code and makes it easier to maintain.

Add song jump and UI enhancements

Implemented functionality to jump to the current song in the ViewModel and attached property for data grid scrolling. Enhanced UI responsiveness with mouse-over effects and improved some styling details.

Refactor LyricsController to simplify access key handling

Removed the private field for AccessKeysContainer and passed it directly to methods. Simplified the code by eliminating unnecessary initialization. Additionally, aligned the ProgressRing in ShellView.xaml for better UI consistency.

Add error handling and text wrapping in ShellView

Enabled text wrapping and scrolling for SongLyrics TextBox in ShellView. Added try-catch block in GeniusAccessStartupTask to handle exceptions and reset GeniusToken upon failure.

Switch to Task.Run for lyrics fetching

Replaced RunAsync with Task.Run to offload the lyrics fetching operation to a separate thread, thereby improving the responsiveness of the UI. This change ensures that long-running tasks do not block the main thread, enhancing user experience.
